## Design Decision

* [Flip the τ and soft-all defaults on today's guard statistics](D1-flip-on-todays-statistics.md) - Decided: V0 found both guards pass under the flipped defaults at the tip, with measured false-alarm rates at or below their Gaussian design, so neither statistic changes; both defaults flip together, the banked layer is re-run under them before the σ calibrations are re-recorded, and the jj composition excess common to both maps is filed on its own.
